title: Compact Burst Conductor Kiosk: concise controls for GPU pool ops
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Design a compact, single-panel operator kiosk for Dedicated GPU pools that surfaces pool health, latency-cost tradeoffs, and lightweight burst/autoscale controls for on-call operators and platform builders. The kiosk is intended as a condensed alternative to the full Pool Ops dashboard for fast triage and one-click mitigation actions.
ux_goals: Show 90th/95th token latency and cost-per-1k for active models in one glance
Make burst enable/disable, max-burst-capacity, and hysteresis quick-editable through a compact UI
Expose rollback and canary switch for model variants used by the pool
Provide clear affordances for safety: required confirmations for destructive actions and visible fallback rules
Optimize for keyboard-first triage workflows and accessible color contrast on health bands
primary_screens: Kiosk header: pool name, region, current capacity (gpus/instances), overall health badge
Health strip: sparkline for active job queue, node-level live errors, thermal/temperature indicator
Latency/cost stack: comparative bars for selected models and a trend micro-sparkline
Burst control row: toggle (enabled), numeric input for burst limit, burst duration quick presets, hysteresis slider
Autoscale preview: suggested scale-out estimate based on 5m and 1h sustained queue, confidence score, apply button
Mitigation actions: drain-node, add-burst, failover-to-variant, recent incidents link
design_decisions_and_tradeoffs: Condense information density to a single row per pool to minimize operator context switching; tradeoff is hidden detail behind the drill-down.
Show both cost and latency chrome in same view — uses compact microbars instead of full charts to reduce cognitive load; tradeoff is loss of fine-grained trend exploration in kiosk view.
Burst presets (30s/2m/10m) are presented as quick actions to prevent misuse, while an advanced modal allows arbitrary durations with warning affordances.
Default burst limit bound to pool-level max to prevent accidental overallocation; an override requires an audit-comment and PM/Eng approval flow (link to policy).
accessibility_notes: Colorblind-friendly palette for health and severity bands (tested with Coblis contrasts)
All interactive controls keyboard-focusable with visible outlines and aria-label equivalents
Numeric inputs support up/down arrow adjustments and localized number formatting
metrics_for_success: Reduce median time-to-mitigate (TTM) for pool incidents by 20% in first 90 days
Operators report >80% confidence in making burst changes without cross-checking the full dashboard
No increase in post-burst cost spikes above existing baseline (monitor via cost-sherpa alerts)
recent_updates: 2025-03-06: Initial low-fidelity sketches validated with on-call rotation; operators preferred single-row quick actions over multi-modal flows.
2025-03-08: High-fidelity prototype completed; added hysteresis slider after eng raised risk of oscillation during autoscale
2025-03-10: PM review requested — asked for explicit cost-preview micro-chart when a burst action is hovered
2025-03-11: Eng feedback: add an API audit header to confirm burst actions for Private deployments; added audit-comment requirement to the flow
2025-03-12: Design review scheduled with infra and SRE; incorporated accessibility fixes and keyboard shortcuts document
mock_review_feedback: SRE: prefer stronger safeguards for repeated bursts within 1h; suggested cooldown indicator
Infra: confirm UX for pools with mixed GPU types (present as aggregated capacity with per-node drilldown)
PM: want a compact timeline of recent rollouts that touched pool models to correlate regressions
Legal/Compliance: require audit logging link when burst is applied to customer-dedicated pools
engineering_notes_for_handoff: Expose a single API endpoint /pools/{id}/kiosk-metrics returning summarized health, 90/95 latencies, cost-per-1k, and autoscale-suggestion payload
Burst action should call /pools/{id}/burst with reason, duration, and operator_id; UI must capture audit-comment header
All control components should reuse design-tokens globals; see token branch PR#88 for spacing and color variables
Fallback UX: if API returns stale data (>30s), show staleness banner and disable destructive actions
next_steps: Finalize interactions after design review on 2025-03-13
Build prototype test script and recruit 6 on-call operators for moderated usability session (target date 2025-03-18)
Coordinate with Eng to wire the kiosk-read endpoint as a feature-flagged rollout for stage->prod
Document audit and compliance flow with Privacy/Legal for dedicated/private pools
